name: dynamic_stop_regime_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 60-second EMA crosses above the 3-minute EMA while the index is trading above session VWAP, it signals that short-term institutional order flow is accelerating faster than the medium-term drift — typically the early signature of a TWAP/VWAP algorithm that has absorbed initial supply and is now moving the market directionally. The critical adaptation for option premium management at 5-second resolution: NIFTY's ATR percentile over the preceding 10 minutes reliably classifies the microstructure volatility regime. In compressed-volatility regimes (ATR percentile < 30), EMA crossovers generate clean 15-25 spot-point directional moves that translate to 3-5 option premium points, and tight 3-point stops work because noise is minimal. In high-volatility bursts (ATR percentile > 70), the same crossover signal requires 7-point premium stops to survive the inevitable retest before the 12-point continuation move materializes — failing to widen stops in these regimes is the primary source of noise-triggered exits on NIFTY.
core_signal_oneliner: 60-second EMA crosses 3-minute EMA with VWAP alignment and volume confirmation, with stop size dynamically set to 3/5/7 points based on 10-minute ATR percentile regime
